svg.script: var PW=1184,MG=8;function G(){return document.getElementsByClassName('fg');}function trunc(l,w){var m=Math.floor(w/6.1);return l.length<=m?l:(m>1?l.slice(0,m-1)+'…':'');}function s(g){document.getElementById('details').textContent=g.getAttribute('data-n')+' — '+(+g.getAttribute('data-s')).toLocaleString()+' samples ('+g.getAttribute('data-p')+'% of on-CPU)';}function c(){document.getElementById('details').textContent='';}function put(g,x,w,show){var r=g.getElementsByTagName('rect')[0],t=g.getElementsByTagName('text')[0];if(!show){g.style.display='none';return;}g.style.display='';r.setAttribute('x',x.toFixed(2));r.setAttribute('width',Math.max(w-0.4,0.3).toFixed(2));if(t){t.setAttribute('x',(x+3).toFixed(2));t.textContent=w>44?trunc(g.getAttribute('data-l'),w):'';}}function zoom(g){var cx=+g.getAttribute('data-x'),cw=+g.getAttribute('data-w'),cd=+g.getAttribute('data-d'),ra=PW/cw,fs=G();for(var i=0;i<fs.length;i++){var f=fs[i],fx=+f.getAttribute('data-x'),fw=+f.getAttribute('data-w'),fd=+f.getAttribute('data-d');if(fd>=cd&&fx>=cx-0.05&&fx+fw<=cx+cw+0.05){put(f,MG+(fx-cx)*ra,fw*ra,true);}else if(fd<cd&&fx<=cx+0.05&&fx+fw>=cx+cw-0.05){put(f,MG,PW,true);}else{put(f,0,0,false);}}}function unzoom(){var fs=G();for(var i=0;i<fs.length;i++){var f=fs[i];put(f,+f.getAttribute('data-x'),+f.getAttribute('data-w'),true);}}function init(){}
